description: This Java class implements a service for managing user settings related to dashboards in the Thingsboard platform, including tracking visited and starred dashboards, updating titles, and handling user actions.

classes.name: DefaultTbUserSettingsService
classes.description: Service class for managing user dashboard settings, including visited and starred dashboards, with methods for updating, retrieving, and refreshing dashboard titles.

methods.name: saveUserSettings
methods.description: Saves user settings for a tenant.

methods.name: updateUserSettings
methods.description: Updates user settings for a specific user and setting type.

methods.name: findUserSettings
methods.description: Retrieves user settings for a user and setting type.

methods.name: deleteUserSettings
methods.description: Deletes specific user settings based on JSON paths.

methods.name: findUserDashboardsInfo
methods.description: Retrieves and refreshes the user's dashboards info, including titles.

methods.name: reportUserDashboardAction
methods.description: Records a user action (visit, star, unstar) on a dashboard and updates stored info.

methods.name: addToVisited
methods.description: Adds a dashboard to the visited list with timestamp.

methods.name: removeFromStarred
methods.description: Removes a dashboard from the starred list.

methods.name: addToStarred
methods.description: Adds a dashboard to the starred list with timestamp.

methods.name: filterById
methods.description: Creates a predicate to filter dashboards by UUID.

methods.name: refreshDashboardTitles
methods.description: Refreshes dashboard titles in user dashboards info by querying dashboard service.
